A popover that cycles tools through Auto -> Ask -> Off -> On. The resulting `Record<name, ToolMode>` is meant to be forwarded to the backend (e.g. via `<Chat body={{ toolPreferences }}>`).

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/ai/ToolPreferences.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { ToolPreferences } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/ai";
```
